proposals.evidence: CDIAL 2462.2 *ekka explicitly gives Gawarbati yak, Bashkarik ak/akh and Maiyan ak one. The retained velar selects this branch; aykh/æk retain the same stem with survey vowel variation. Exact survey form yak is retained.
